# BHD Asia

> BHD Asia (Business & Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd, UEN 201201974K) is a boutique HR consulting, executive coaching and resilience-building consultancy founded in Singapore in 2012 by Isabelle Claus Teixeira. It co-designs leadership development, organisation development and TRE™ (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises) programmes for organisations across Europe, the US, Asia, Japan and Russia. Coaching is offered in English, French and Spanish. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute discovery call.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2012, Singapore. Address: 50 Raffles Place, Singapore Land Tower #30-00, Singapore 048623.
- Founder and Director: Isabelle Claus Teixeira — 30+ years of senior HR experience across 9 countries, certified leadership coach since 2012, 1,800+ coaching hours, ICF certification, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer.
- Team: executive coaches, an organisational psychologist and a somatic practitioner / TRE™ specialist (four people).
- Approach: co-designed, never off-the-shelf; diagnostics are always part of the process.
- Delivery: in person in Singapore and worldwide, and online.
- Clients include ByteDance (TikTok), NTT DATA, Novartis, Philips, Heineken APAC, VISA, Mastercard, Levi Strauss Japan, Alcon, Gilead and Robert Walters.
- Contact: the enquiry form at https://bhdasia.com/contact · +81 80 6515 1778

## Services

- [Services overview](https://bhdasia.com/services): three service areas plus two coaching packages.
- [Organisation Development](https://bhdasia.com/services#org): HR & talent management advisory, high-performing teams facilitation, challenging conversations & constructive conflict management, leadership skills development, organisation culture transformation, change management skills.
- [Resilience Building](https://bhdasia.com/services#resilience): somatic coaching, TRE™, stress management & burnout prevention, psychological safety workshops, conflict resolution.
- [Individual Development](https://bhdasia.com/services#individual): executive coaching, transition coaching, performance coaching, career coaching, self-awareness development, 360° debrief.
- [Corporate Coaching Package](https://bhdasia.com/services#corporate-coaching): from SGD 6,000 for 8 one-on-one sessions, with an initial diagnostic, work between sessions and a follow-up review.
- [New Leader Accelerator Program](https://bhdasia.com/services#new-leader): for newly appointed leaders — role diagnostics, up to 6 coaching sessions, stakeholder feedback and a personalised 90-day leadership action plan; priced per engagement.
- [Book a discovery call](https://bhdasia.com/contact): free, 30 minutes, no commitment.

## Frequently asked questions

- What does BHD Asia do? Boutique HR consulting, executive coaching and resilience building from Singapore since 2012, with co-designed programmes for organisations worldwide.
- What is TRE™? Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises: simple exercises that activate the body's natural tremoring to release stress and tension without detailed discussion. BHD Asia runs TRE™ workshops and the Global TRE™ Provider Certification.
- How much does executive coaching cost? The Corporate Coaching Package starts from SGD 6,000 for 8 sessions; other programmes are priced per engagement.
- Do you work outside Singapore? Yes — Europe, the US, Asia, Japan and the Middle East, in person and online.
- Which languages? English, French and Spanish, with partner coaches for other languages.
- How do I start? Book a free 30-minute discovery call at https://bhdasia.com/contact.
